title: Farol Protocol v0.5 — widget/get
description: Request and response envelopes for the widget/get method. See protocol/SPEC.md §5.2 for the normative polling model. The core calls this once per refresh cycle, per widget declared in the handshake result (protocol/SPEC.md §6.3) - the plugin MUST NOT push widget data unsolicited. This file also defines GitRepository, RemoteStatus, MonitorStatusItem, VpnConnectionState/VpnProfile/VpnStatusItem and ContainerState/ContainerStatusItem; it references ActionDeclaration from handshake.schema.json. Evolved from v0.4 (protocol/schema/v0.4/widget.schema.json, retained as-is): WidgetGetResult gains a required `kind` field (WidgetItemKind: "Git"/"Monitor"/"Vpn"/"Container") at the envelope level, replacing the `anyOf` over `items` with an `if`/`then` keyed on `kind` (specs/010-widget-detail-surface, issue #9) - eliminates the incidental-field-disjunction dependency for choosing the shape of `items`; a fifth item type in the future no longer requires re-analyzing the disjunction of every existing variant's required fields. GitRepository/RemoteStatus/WidgetItem (kind "status-grid"), MonitorStatusItem (kind "monitor-status-grid"), VpnConnectionState/VpnProfile/VpnStatusItem (kind "vpn-status") and ContainerState/ContainerStatusItem (kind "container-status-grid") are unchanged, copied as-is from v0.4.

widget_id.description: Must match the `id` of a WidgetDeclaration returned by this plugin's handshake/hello result.

RemoteStatus.title: RemoteStatus
RemoteStatus.description: Discriminated union on `kind`. "no_remote" is a distinct serialization from a tracked repo reporting 0 ahead / 0 behind - the core never has to infer "no remote" from an absent field. "no_upstream_tracking" (new in v0.2, technical debt #3 / issue #3, specs/002-uptime-kuma-plugin/tasks.md T049) is a third distinct state: a remote is configured (unlike no_remote), but the current branch has no tracking branch (`@{u}`) set, so ahead/behind are not computable - distinct from both no_remote and from a genuine 0 ahead / 0 behind. Not present in v0.1 (protocol/schema/v0.1/widget.schema.json, retained as-is / frozen historical).

ahead.description: Commits ahead of the configured upstream.

oneOf.title: RemoteStatusNoUpstreamTracking
oneOf.description: A remote is configured, but the current branch has no upstream tracking branch set - ahead/behind are unknown, not zero.

GitRepository.title: GitRepository
GitRepository.description: One repository item reported by widget/get.

id.description: Stable identifier - the repository's absolute filesystem path.

name.description: Short display name (e.g. the directory name).

dirty.description: true = working tree has pending changes; false = clean.

remote_status.description: MUST be kind="no_remote" if and only if this repository's corresponding fetch ActionDeclaration has enabled=false (protocol/SPEC.md invariant carried over from data-model.md).

WidgetItem.title: WidgetItem
WidgetItem.description: Pairs one GitRepository with its corresponding fetch ActionDeclaration. This is how the actions[] list, possibly empty at handshake time, reaches the core in practice (protocol/SPEC.md §6.3.1). Exclusive to widgets declared with kind="status-grid" - unchanged from v0.1.

MonitorStatusItem.title: MonitorStatusItem
MonitorStatusItem.description: One monitor item reported by widget/get for a widget declared with kind="monitor-status-grid" (new in v0.2, research.md D4, data-model.md §1.3). Reported by the uptime-kuma reference plugin. Unlike WidgetItem, it never carries an ActionDeclaration - this plugin never declares actions (FR-004); the field simply does not exist on this type, it is not an empty optional field.

name.description: Monitor display name, from the `monitor_name` label of the /metrics response - possibly sanitized relative to the original Uptime Kuma display name.

status.description: Mapped from the raw `monitor_status` value: 1->up, 0->down, 2->pending, 3->maintenance. A raw value outside {0,1,2,3} does not produce this item - it invalidates the entire widget/get response for that read (reason "metrics_parse_error", see error-model-delta.md).

response_time_ms.description: From `monitor_response_time` (ms), when applicable to the monitor's status; explicit null when not applicable - an explicit union, never inferred from an absent field (same spirit as RemoteStatus.NoRemote in v0.1). Required and nullable, never absent. Never negative - a response time is a duration.

VpnConnectionState.title: VpnConnectionState
VpnConnectionState.description: New in v0.3 (research.md D3, data-model.md §1.1). Mirrors StatusPayload.state of the openfortivpn-gui CLI status --json output. There is deliberately no "error" variant here - a failure to read VPN state (the CLI missing from PATH, or an ErrorPayload/internal_error from the CLI itself) is reported as a widget/get protocol error (code -32008 / reason "vpn_status_unavailable", see error.schema.json), never squeezed into this enum - the same reasoning already applied to RemoteStatus and MonitorStatusItem.status in this schema set: an observable state is distinct from a read failure.

VpnProfile.title: VpnProfile
VpnProfile.description: New in v0.3 (research.md D4, data-model.md §1.2). One VPN profile the openfortivpn-gui reference plugin knows about, paired with the ActionDeclaration that connects to it - same pattern as WidgetItem pairing GitRepository with fetch_action, one level down (per profile, not per widget item), because it is the profile - not the widget as a whole - that is the target of vpn.connect.

name.description: Profile display name, as known to the openfortivpn-gui CLI.

connect_action.description: id "vpn.connect", target {type: "vpn-profile", id: <this profile's name>}. MUST have enabled=true if and only if VpnStatusItem.state == "disconnected" (research.md D4) - mirrors the existing invariant between WidgetItem.fetch_action.enabled and repo.remote_status.kind == "no_remote".

VpnStatusItem.title: VpnStatusItem
VpnStatusItem.description: New in v0.3 (research.md D2-D4, data-model.md §1.3). The item shape reported by widget/get for a widget declared with kind="vpn-status", by the openfortivpn-gui reference plugin. Unlike WidgetItem/MonitorStatusItem, WidgetGetResult.items for this kind is a singleton - always an array of zero or one VpnStatusItem, reflecting that there is at most one active VPN session at a time (research.md D3) - not a list of N independent items.

active_profile.description: Mirrors selected_profile of the CLI. Explicit null when no profile is selected/active, never inferred from an absent field.

elapsed_seconds.description: Some only when state == "connected" (mirrors session.elapsed_seconds of the CLI when session is not null); explicit null when not applicable, never inferred from an absent field - same spirit as MonitorStatusItem.response_time_ms. Required and nullable, never absent. Never negative - a duration.

available_profiles.description: All VPN profiles known to the plugin, each paired with its own connect_action (research.md D4). MAY be empty if the CLI reports no configured profiles.

disconnect_action.description: id "vpn.disconnect", target {type: "vpn-connection", id: "active"}. MUST have enabled=true if and only if state == "connected" (research.md D4).

ContainerState.title: ContainerState
ContainerState.description: New in v0.4 (research.md D1, D3, data-model.md §1.2). Estado do container. As sete primeiras são o vocabulário publicado pelo Docker, mapeadas 1:1 do campo `State` de `docker ps`. `unknown` NUNCA é emitido pelo Docker: é produzido pelo plugin ao encontrar um valor fora do vocabulário (FR-012), e implica nenhuma ação acionável.

ContainerStatusItem.title: ContainerStatusItem
ContainerStatusItem.description: New in v0.4 (research.md D1-D4, D6, D12, data-model.md §1.3). One container item reported by widget/get for a widget declared with kind="container-status-grid", by the docker-containers reference plugin. Unlike VpnStatusItem, WidgetGetResult.items for this kind is a list of N independent items, one per local Docker container (including non-running ones, FR-011) - not a singleton, same shape as WidgetItem/MonitorStatusItem. Invariants validated by contract test (data-model.md §1.3, invariants 1-6): id is 64 lowercase hex chars from `docker ps --no-trunc`, name/image are never empty, the three ActionDeclaration are always present with an identical target {type: "docker-container", id: <this item's id>}, their id fields are "docker.container.start"/"stop"/"restart", enabled follows the FR-008 matrix exactly, and timeout_hint_ms is always present (20000/35000/45000). status_text is auxiliary and human only - no consumer may derive state from it; the field is deliberately named status_text, not status, to avoid a structural collision with MonitorStatusItem in the untagged disambiguation of WidgetItems (research.md D12).

id.description: Full container ID (64 hex chars, from `docker ps --no-trunc`). Stable identity for FR-013 and the merge key for UI reconciliation (data-model.md §2.3). NEVER the name.

name.description: Display name. First name when the CLI reports several (research.md D1); never empty.

image.description: Source image: tag when one exists, image identifier otherwise (research.md D1). Never empty.

status_text.description: Auxiliary human text from the CLI (e.g. "Up 38 hours (healthy)"). Purely informational - the core MUST NOT derive state from it (research.md D1). Explicit null when unavailable, never inferred from an absent field - required and nullable, never absent, same spirit as VpnStatusItem.elapsed_seconds and MonitorStatusItem.response_time_ms.

start_action.description: id "docker.container.start", target {type: "docker-container", id: <this item's id>}. enabled follows the FR-008 matrix (data-model.md §1.3 invariant 5); timeout_hint_ms MUST be 20000 (research.md D6).

stop_action.description: id "docker.container.stop", target {type: "docker-container", id: <this item's id>}. enabled follows the FR-008 matrix (data-model.md §1.3 invariant 5); timeout_hint_ms MUST be 35000 (research.md D6).

restart_action.description: id "docker.container.restart", target {type: "docker-container", id: <this item's id>}. enabled follows the FR-008 matrix (data-model.md §1.3 invariant 5); timeout_hint_ms MUST be 45000 (research.md D6).

WidgetItemKind.title: WidgetItemKind
WidgetItemKind.description: New in v0.5 (specs/010-widget-detail-surface, issue #9). Explicit discriminator, at the WidgetGetResult envelope level, identifying which shape `items` uses. Mirrors the four WidgetItems variant names on the Rust binding (Git/Monitor/Vpn/Container) exactly, to minimize the chance of the wire value diverging from the variant actually chosen when deserializing. Replaces the previous approach of inferring the shape of `items` from the incidental disjunction of required fields across WidgetItem/MonitorStatusItem/VpnStatusItem/ContainerStatusItem (research.md D12, feature 005) - that disjunction was never guaranteed by design and would have required manual re-analysis for every future fifth item type.
WidgetItemKind.$comment: Consistency between `kind` and the actual content of `items` is enforced at parse time, not by a later consistency check: the farol-protocol Rust binding's custom Deserialize for WidgetGetResult reads `kind` first and only then deserializes `items` into the corresponding variant - by construction, a WidgetGetResult never carries a `kind` that lies about the shape of `items`. This schema mirrors the same rule declaratively via if/then below.

WidgetGetResult.title: WidgetGetResult
WidgetGetResult.description: `kind` (new in v0.5, required) explicitly identifies the shape of `items`: WidgetItem[] when kind="Git" (widget_id declared with kind="status-grid"), MonitorStatusItem[] when kind="Monitor" (widget_id declared with kind="monitor-status-grid"), VpnStatusItem[] (always length 0 or 1, research.md D3) when kind="Vpn" (widget_id declared with kind="vpn-status"), or ContainerStatusItem[] when kind="Container" (widget_id declared with kind="container-status-grid"). Before v0.5 this shape was inferred from the incidental disjunction of required fields across the four item types (protocol/schema/v0.4/widget.schema.json, research.md D12) - kind now makes that choice explicit and structurally sound regardless of field overlap between item types, current or future.

widget_id.description: Echoes the widget_id from the request.

items.description: MAY be empty for any kind - a configured scan root with no repositories under it, an Uptime Kuma instance with no monitors registered, a VPN plugin momentarily unable to represent status as a singleton item, or a machine with no Docker containers at all (FR-011, a normal and common case for this kind), are all valid states, not errors.

WidgetGetResponseError.title: WidgetGetResponseError
WidgetGetResponseError.description: E.g. code -32004 / reason "scan_root_unreadable" (git-local), or code -32005/-32006/-32007 / reason "not_configured"/"metrics_unreachable"/"metrics_parse_error" (uptime-kuma). A pointwise error here does not, by itself, mark the plugin connection unavailable - the core keeps the last known items (protocol/SPEC.md §5.2).
